provenance.note: the required-flags exemption matches the built-in help command by name, so a user-defined command named help runs with its required flags never enforced; the base already let such a command run — command_run.go returned early on `cmd.Name == helpName` before this PR moved the exemption into checkAllRequiredFlags — so base and head behave alike here, and only the added name test is new

bugs.note: cmd.Name == helpName exempts every command called help, including a user-defined one, from checkRequiredFlags; the fix adds a builtInHelp marker and tests that instead
